title: Metre Convention
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Metre Convention", at revision 1382160352, opens: "The Metre Convention, also known as the Treaty of the Metre, is an international treaty that was signed in Paris on 20 May 1875 by representatives of 17 sovereign states: Argentina, Austria-Hungary, Belgium, Brazil, Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, Peru, Portugal, Russia, Spain, Sweden-Norway, Switzerland, the Ottoman Empire, the United States, and Venezuela." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q217429, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1875 international treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
